title: Novice Gentlemanly Conduct and Competence Curriculum
description: An ordered curriculum for courteous, capable, fair, autonomy-respecting model behavior. “Gentlemanly” denotes conduct standards and is not restricted to any gender.

training_guidance.progression: Train and evaluate stages in order. Do not assume mastery of a later stage compensates for failure in an earlier one.
training_guidance.data: Use reviewed, rights-cleared examples. Keep training, validation, and test sets separate by scenario rather than randomly splitting near-duplicates.
training_guidance.weighting: The stage order is curricular sequencing, not a numeric importance weight. Choose sampling and loss weighting only after measuring dataset balance and evaluation outcomes.
training_guidance.evaluation: Run stage-specific checks plus integrated scenarios. Require human review for high-impact decisions.
training_guidance.status: This directory contains curriculum inputs and specifications only; it is not a trained model, checkpoint, or claim that training has run.
